WITH population AS (SELECT u.* FROM public.profiles u  WHERE u.channel <> 'organic' AND u.first_seen >= CAST('2019-06-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AND u.first_seen < CAST('2019-07-01' AS TIMESTAMP)),
per_user AS (SELECT u.user_id,u.first_seen,u.channel AS channel, '__all' AS segment,COUNT(p.purchase_id) AS n_purchases,COALESCE(SUM(p.amount),0) AS revenue_amount,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.purchase_index=1 THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS first_amount,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.purchase_index>1 THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS repeat_amount,MIN(CASE WHEN p.purchase_index=1 THEN (unix_timestamp(p.purchased_at)-unix_timestamp(u.first_seen))/3600.0 ELSE NULL END) AS first_hours FROM population u LEFT JOIN public.purchase_facts p ON p.user_id=u.user_id AND p.purchased_at >= u.first_seen AND p.purchased_at < u.first_seen + INTERVAL '14' DAY GROUP BY u.user_id,u.first_seen,u.channel),
user_agg AS (SELECT channel, segment,COUNT(*) AS n_users,SUM(CASE WHEN first_seen >= CAST('2019-06-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AND first_seen < CAST('2019-07-01' AS TIMESTAMP) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_new,SUM(CASE WHEN n_purchases>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_payers,SUM(CASE WHEN n_purchases>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_repeat_payers,SUM(n_purchases) AS n_purchases,SUM(revenue_amount) AS revenue_amount,SUM(first_amount) AS first_amount,SUM(repeat_amount) AS repeat_amount,AVG(first_hours) AS first_hours FROM per_user GROUP BY channel, segment),
session_agg AS (SELECT u.channel AS channel, '__all' AS segment,COUNT(*) AS n_sessions FROM population u JOIN public.visits v ON u.user_id=v.user_id AND v.started_at >= u.first_seen AND v.started_at < u.first_seen + INTERVAL '14' DAY GROUP BY u.channel),
cost_agg AS (SELECT c.channel,'__all' AS segment,SUM(c.amount) AS spend_amount FROM public.costs c WHERE c.cost_date >= CAST('2019-06-01' AS DATE) AND c.cost_date < CAST('2019-07-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY c.channel),
keys AS (SELECT channel, segment FROM user_agg UNION SELECT channel, segment FROM session_agg UNION SELECT channel, segment FROM cost_agg) SELECT k.channel, k.segment,COALESCE(u.n_users,0) AS n_users,COALESCE(u.n_new,0) AS n_new,COALESCE(u.n_payers,0) AS n_payers,COALESCE(u.n_repeat_payers,0) AS n_repeat_payers,COALESCE(u.n_purchases,0) AS n_purchases,COALESCE(u.revenue_amount,0) AS revenue_amount,COALESCE(u.first_amount,0) AS first_amount,COALESCE(u.repeat_amount,0) AS repeat_amount,u.first_hours,COALESCE(s.n_sessions,0) AS n_sessions,c.spend_amount FROM keys k LEFT JOIN user_agg u ON k.channel=u.channel AND k.segment=u.segment LEFT JOIN session_agg s ON k.channel=s.channel AND k.segment=s.segment LEFT JOIN cost_agg c ON k.channel=c.channel AND k.segment=c.segment ORDER BY k.channel, k.segment LIMIT 201

WITH activity AS (SELECT CAST(CAST(date_trunc('day',started_at) AS DATE) AS VARCHAR(10)) AS bucket,user_id FROM public.visits WHERE started_at >= CAST('2019-06-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AND started_at < CAST('2019-07-01' AS TIMESTAMP) UNION SELECT CAST(CAST(date_trunc('day',purchased_at) AS DATE) AS VARCHAR(10)) AS bucket,user_id FROM public.purchases WHERE purchased_at >= CAST('2019-06-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AND purchased_at < CAST('2019-07-01' AS TIMESTAMP)),
purchase_user AS (SELECT CAST(CAST(date_trunc('day',p.purchased_at) AS DATE) AS VARCHAR(10)) AS bucket,p.user_id,COUNT(*) AS n_purchases,SUM(p.amount) AS revenue_amount,SUM(CASE WHEN p.purchase_index=1 THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS first_amount,SUM(CASE WHEN p.purchase_index>1 THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_amount,MIN(CASE WHEN p.purchase_index=1 THEN (unix_timestamp(p.purchased_at)-unix_timestamp(u.first_seen))/3600.0 ELSE NULL END) AS first_hours FROM public.purchase_facts p JOIN public.profiles u ON p.user_id=u.user_id WHERE p.purchased_at >= CAST('2019-06-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AND p.purchased_at < CAST('2019-07-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AND u.channel <> 'organic' GROUP BY CAST(CAST(date_trunc('day',p.purchased_at) AS DATE) AS VARCHAR(10)),p.user_id),
user_agg AS (SELECT a.bucket,COUNT(*) AS n_users,SUM(CASE WHEN u.first_seen >= CAST('2019-06-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AND u.first_seen < CAST('2019-07-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST(CAST(date_trunc('day',u.first_seen) AS DATE) AS VARCHAR(10))=a.bucket THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_new,SUM(CASE WHEN p.n_purchases>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_payers,SUM(CASE WHEN p.n_purchases>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_repeat_payers,COALESCE(SUM(p.n_purchases),0) AS n_purchases,COALESCE(SUM(p.revenue_amount),0) AS revenue_amount,COALESCE(SUM(p.first_amount),0) AS first_amount,COALESCE(SUM(p.repeat_amount),0) AS repeat_amount,AVG(p.first_hours) AS first_hours FROM activity a JOIN public.profiles u ON a.user_id=u.user_id LEFT JOIN purchase_user p ON a.user_id=p.user_id AND a.bucket=p.bucket WHERE u.channel <> 'organic' GROUP BY a.bucket),
session_agg AS (SELECT CAST(CAST(date_trunc('day',v.started_at) AS DATE) AS VARCHAR(10)) AS bucket,COUNT(*) AS n_sessions FROM public.visits v JOIN public.profiles u ON v.user_id=u.user_id WHERE v.started_at >= CAST('2019-06-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AND v.started_at < CAST('2019-07-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AND u.channel <> 'organic' GROUP BY CAST(CAST(date_trunc('day',v.started_at) AS DATE) AS VARCHAR(10))),
cost_agg AS (SELECT CAST(CAST(date_trunc('day',c.cost_date) AS DATE) AS VARCHAR(10)) AS bucket,SUM(c.amount) AS spend_amount FROM public.costs c WHERE c.cost_date >= CAST('2019-06-01' AS DATE) AND c.cost_date < CAST('2019-07-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY CAST(CAST(date_trunc('day',c.cost_date) AS DATE) AS VARCHAR(10))),
keys AS (SELECT bucket FROM user_agg UNION SELECT bucket FROM session_agg UNION SELECT bucket FROM cost_agg) SELECT k.bucket,COALESCE(u.n_users,0) AS n_users,COALESCE(u.n_new,0) AS n_new,COALESCE(u.n_payers,0) AS n_payers,COALESCE(u.n_repeat_payers,0) AS n_repeat_payers,COALESCE(u.n_purchases,0) AS n_purchases,COALESCE(u.revenue_amount,0) AS revenue_amount,COALESCE(u.first_amount,0) AS first_amount,COALESCE(u.repeat_amount,0) AS repeat_amount,u.first_hours,COALESCE(s.n_sessions,0) AS n_sessions,c.spend_amount FROM keys k LEFT JOIN user_agg u ON k.bucket=u.bucket LEFT JOIN session_agg s ON k.bucket=s.bucket LEFT JOIN cost_agg c ON k.bucket=c.bucket ORDER BY k.bucket LIMIT 201
